title: sqlparse: Bug report (issue #782) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is sqlparse (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #782) from a user of this library:

> `sqlparse.format(sql, strip_whitespace=True)` leaves trailing whitespace and line breaks in place when they are inside a group, such as a parenthesis or a sub-select, while the same whitespace at the top level is removed. All of it should be stripped.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
